rtm_flows.req: Land Module -> Architect Workflow: EE creates Land ID, completes land activities & forwards to CA
rtm_flows.desc: Authority login, Land creation, data persistence, forward, ownership transfer & module transition validation

rtm_flows.req: In-House Architect Workflow: CA -> In-House Architect -> AA -> Draftsman
rtm_flows.desc: Sub Land creation & parent linkage, In-House selection, document association, ownership transfers & routing restriction

rtm_flows.req: Reverse Approval & Final Approval: Draftsman -> AA -> In-House Architect -> CA
rtm_flows.desc: Reverse paths as per permissions, history accuracy, document integrity & final approval/completion
Competition creation against Sub Land, Note Sheet, duration, publish & CMS visibility/date sync

rtm_flows.req: CMS Empanelment Integration: Registration -> Application -> CA Approval -> Payment -> Active
rtm_flows.desc: CMS registration, application sync to CA, approval, payment, activation & competition eligibility
Competition visibility, multiple applications, date window enforcement, single winner selection & CMS reflection

rtm_flows.req: Competition Workflow Integration: CA -> DHC -> EE -> Empanelled Architect
rtm_flows.desc: LoA, Work Order, Agreement, winner-only visibility, CMS-Authority document synchronization & return routing

rtm_flows.req: Reverse Competition & Final Approval: Emp Architect -> EE -> DHC -> CA
rtm_flows.desc: Reverse ownership transfers, document/version integrity, completion in both modules & end-to-end consistency

rtm_flows.req: Legacy Land Processing (Part 2 of Land Module): EE retrieves migrated Land via Advanced Filter (Is Migrated Data = Yes), completes minimum data & forwards to CA using the same Land ID
rtm_flows.desc: Advanced Filter retrieval, existing Land ID (no new ID), NA defaults, Land Type & Area > 0 validations, relaxed document rule, forwarding, ownership transfer, CA document visibility (uploaded vs missing), negative scenarios & data consistency

test_cases.section: Integration Flow 1 - Land Module -> Architect Workflow (EE -> CA)
steps: 1 Open Authority Login page
2 Enter valid EE credentials
3 Click Login

2 EE dashboard should display Land module options as per assigned role & permissions.
3 Menus/actions of other roles should not be visible to EE.

test_cases.section: Integration Flow 1 - Land Module -> Architect Workflow (EE -> CA)

test_cases.section: Integration Flow 1 - Land Module -> Architect Workflow (EE -> CA)

test_cases.section: Integration Flow 1 - Land Module -> Architect Workflow (EE -> CA)
